title: Building
summary: Collaborations around the products he already publishes: MoneyRadar and Thugir Labs.
body:
MoneyRadar is a set of free finance calculators and guides for India. The site says they are not SEBI advice. Thugir Labs is a closed beta for security research. Thugir Group is the parent of both, and Ryan is the founder.

A collaboration starts from the form. This page does not describe how the research runs, and it does not quote a fee.
